use_when: 전체 또는 요금제·연령대별 가입자 수를 확인할 때
fixed_sql: select as_of_date,plan_id,plan_name,age_band,subscriber_count from ai_operations.v_subscriber_current where as_of_date=$1::date order by subscriber_count desc,plan_id,age_band

select plan_id,plan_name,sum(subscriber_count)::integer subscriber_count from ai_operations.v_subscriber_current where as_of_date=$1::date group by plan_id,plan_name order by subscriber_count desc,plan_id
limitations: 현재 요금제만 사용하며 이력 스냅샷 없음

description: 기간 내 일별 사용량과 사용 사용자 수를 조회
fixed_sql: select calendar_date,round(sum(total_usage_mb),1) total_usage_mb,sum(usage_user_count)::integer segment_user_count from ai_operations.v_daily_usage_segment where calendar_date between $1::date and $2::date group by calendar_date order by calendar_date
limitations: segment_user_count는 세그먼트별 중복 합계이므로 고유 가입자 수가 아님

fixed_sql: select calendar_month,round(sum(total_usage_mb),1) total_usage_mb from ai_operations.v_monthly_usage_segment where calendar_month between date_trunc('month',$1::date)::date and date_trunc('month',$2::date)::date group by calendar_month order by calendar_month

use_when: 운영 콘텐츠 카테고리 비중을 확인할 때
fixed_sql: select content_category,round(sum(total_usage_mb),1) total_usage_mb from ai_operations.v_daily_usage_segment where calendar_date between $1::date and $2::date group by content_category order by total_usage_mb desc,content_category

select plan_id,plan_name,age_band,content_category,round(total_usage_mb,1) total_usage_mb,usage_user_count,round(average_usage_mb,1) average_usage_mb from ai_operations.v_monthly_usage_segment where calendar_month=to_date($1||'-01','YYYY-MM-DD') order by total_usage_mb desc

description: 최근 N일 고사용 가명 고객을 조회
use_when: 운영 점검용 고사용 고객군이 필요할 때
fixed_sql: with m as (select max(calendar_date) d from ai_operations.v_customer_daily_usage) select analysis_user_key,round(sum(total_usage_mb),1) total_usage_mb from ai_operations.v_customer_daily_usage cross join m where calendar_date between m.d-$1::integer+1 and m.d group by analysis_user_key order by total_usage_mb desc limit $2::integer

description: 최근 N일 저사용 가명 고객을 조회
fixed_sql: with m as (select max(calendar_date) d from ai_operations.v_customer_daily_usage) select analysis_user_key,round(sum(total_usage_mb),1) total_usage_mb from ai_operations.v_customer_daily_usage cross join m where calendar_date between m.d-$1::integer+1 and m.d group by analysis_user_key order by total_usage_mb,analysis_user_key limit $2::integer
limitations: 사용량이 전혀 없는 고객은 포함하지 않음

description: 가명 고객별 월 최다 사용 카테고리와 비중을 조회
use_when: 카테고리 집중 이용 고객을 찾을 때
fixed_sql: with x as (select *,sum(total_usage_mb) over(partition by analysis_user_key,calendar_month) all_mb,row_number() over(partition by analysis_user_key,calendar_month order by total_usage_mb desc,content_category) rn from ai_operations.v_customer_monthly_category_usage where calendar_month=to_date($1||'-01','YYYY-MM-DD')) select analysis_user_key,content_category,round(total_usage_mb,1) total_usage_mb,round(total_usage_mb/nullif(all_mb,0),4) usage_ratio from x where rn=1 order by usage_ratio desc,total_usage_mb desc limit $2::integer

select has_bundle,has_kt_internet,count(*)::integer family_count,sum(member_count)::integer member_count from ai_operations.v_family_current group by has_bundle,has_kt_internet order by family_count desc

description: 선택 서비스별 현재 사용자 수를 조회
fixed_sql: select service_id,service_name,service_category,customer_count from ai_operations.v_service_current order by customer_count desc,service_id
select discount_id,discount_name,policy_domain,customer_count from ai_operations.v_discount_current order by customer_count desc,discount_id

description: 최근 N일 개인 일사용량 z-score 이상치를 조회
fixed_sql: with m as (select max(calendar_date) d from ai_operations.v_customer_daily_usage),x as (select u.* from ai_operations.v_customer_daily_usage u cross join m where u.calendar_date between m.d-$1::integer+1 and m.d),s as (select analysis_user_key,avg(total_usage_mb) av,stddev_pop(total_usage_mb) sd from x group by analysis_user_key) select x.analysis_user_key,x.calendar_date,round(x.total_usage_mb,1) total_usage_mb,round((x.total_usage_mb-s.av)/nullif(s.sd,0),2) z_score from x join s using(analysis_user_key) where s.sd>0 and (x.total_usage_mb-s.av)/s.sd>=$2 order by z_score desc limit $3::integer
